details:
• Improved backend data exchange performance by 37% by developing and optimizing Spring Boot MVC services with efficient API design and JPA-based data access.
  • Architected a certificate lifecycle management system for 200+ BACnet SC devices, strengthening secure communication and enabling scalable onboarding using Core Java and public third-party libraries for a flagship product release.
  • Delivered enterprise React.js dashboards in a multi-team environment, using Redux, SASS, and a shared custom component library to ensure consistent and maintainable UI.
  • Accelerated UI delivery and reduced design-to-development gaps by translating Figma designs into responsive, production-ready dashboards.
  • Increased backend processing capacity under load by implementing multithreaded and concurrent systems in Java.
  • Extended legacy system accessibility by enabling browser-based interaction via RPC-driven client-server communication, reducing operator licensing costs by $200 per user.
  • Improved system efficiency by ~20% by implementing event-driven workflows with subscription-based callbacks, enabling scalable handling of 1000+ history and alarm events.
  • Reduced defects and improved release reliability by enhancing CI/CD pipelines and implementing automated unit and integration testing.
  • Streamlined deployments and reduced environment inconsistencies by containerizing services using Docker and integrating with CI/CD pipelines for faster delivery.
  • Enabled seamless interoperability across distributed systems by integrating BACnet, Modbus, MQTT, and Panel Bus protocols.

• Involved in a large-scale brownfield PSU EPCM project for the Government of India under the guidance of the Chief Engineer.
  • Developed and maintained the instrument index and wiring diagrams.
  • Prepared functional loop schematics and technical specification sheets for control valves and other instrumentation in Smart Plant Instrumentation.
  • Managed purchase orders and coordinated with vendors for timely procurement.
  • Prepared detailed Instrument Hookups and corresponding bills of material for project-wide procurement.
  • Validated and prepared IO counts for DCS, ESD, and FGS systems using P&ID diagrams.

• Built RESTful APIs using Node.js/Express with MongoDB, optimizing query patterns and indexing to reduce latency and improve performance.
  • Developed React components with Redux for efficient state management, minimizing re-renders and improving UI responsiveness.
  • Refactored async workflows and modularized backend routes/middleware, enhancing scalability and reducing redundant API calls (~15% improvement).
Graduated with CGPA 9.65 with an elective of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

Passed with 94%
Represented and led the football team at various state-level tournaments.
